paras: A sink that drains slowly or a tub that takes a long time to empty is usually the first sign of a clog. Soap, hair, grease and everyday debris collect inside drain lines until water can no longer pass freely. {BIZ} is a plumbing company, so drain problems are exactly the kind of call we are set up for.

A drain cleaning visit generally starts with finding out where the blockage is. A clog in one sink is a different problem from several drains slowing down at once, which can point to the main line. Once the location is clear, the drain is cleared with the right method for that line, and water flow is checked afterward. If the clog turns out to be part of a bigger problem, such as a damaged or blocked sewer line, that is the time to talk about next steps.

Kitchen drains tend to collect grease and food particles, while bathroom drains are more likely to hold hair and soap. Toilets can also back up, and a toilet that keeps clogging is worth having checked. Catching a slow drain early is usually simpler than waiting for a full backup.

paras: A drip under the sink or a damp spot on a wall can look minor, but water that keeps escaping can damage cabinets, flooring and drywall over time. {BIZ} finds and repairs leaks in homes across Murfreesboro and the surrounding area.

A leak repair visit generally starts with looking over the area and listening to what you have noticed. Fixtures, fittings, valves and nearby piping are checked to narrow down where the water is coming from. Once the source is found, the repair is made and the line is checked again.
